title: God Who in Various Methods Told
description: God Who in Various Methods Told in Tonic Solfa to MELCOMBE, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 53, headed “The Holy Scriptures, Heb. 1. 1 2. 2 Tim. 3. 15 16. Psalm 147. 19 20”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Long Metre (8.8.8.8). This page sets the words to MELCOMBE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: God who in var-ious meth-ods told His mind and will to saints of old, Sent down his Son, with truth and grace, To teach us in these lat-ter days.

lines: God who in various methods told
His mind and will to saints of old,
Sent down his Son, with truth and grace,
To teach us in these latter days.
Our nation reads the written word,
That book of life, that sure record:
Is by the sweet conveyance given.
God's kindest thoughts are here express'd,
Able to make us wise and bless'd;
Fit for reproof, and comfort too.
Ye British isles, who read his love
(He hath not sent his sacred word
To every land) Praise ye the Lord.

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to MELCOMBE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
